_note: 2024/SRD 5.2 magic items — original paraphrased descriptions; mechanical facts accurate.

magicItems.name: Potion of Healing
magicItems.description: A single dose of red liquid; drinking it as an action restores 2d4 + 2 hit points.

magicItems.name: Potion of Greater Healing
magicItems.description: Drinking this potion as an action recovers 4d4 + 4 hit points.

magicItems.name: Potion of Superior Healing
magicItems.description: Drinking this potion as an action recovers 8d4 + 8 hit points.

magicItems.name: Potion of Supreme Healing
magicItems.description: Drinking this potion as an action recovers 10d4 + 20 hit points.

magicItems.name: Bag of Holding
magicItems.description: An extradimensional pouch that holds up to 500 pounds (about 64 cubic feet) while weighing only 15 pounds. Overloading it or piercing it destroys the bag and scatters the contents across the Astral Plane.

magicItems.name: Portable Hole
magicItems.description: A cloth circle that unfolds into a 10-foot-deep extradimensional pit 6 feet across; fold it up to seal the opening and carry whatever is inside. Placing it inside a bag of holding ruptures both into the Astral Plane.

magicItems.name: Immovable Rod
magicItems.description: A flat iron bar with a button that fixes it in place in midair, bearing up to 8,000 pounds. A DC 30 Strength check moves it 10 feet; press the button again to release it.

magicItems.name: Cloak of Protection
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, this cloak grants a +1 bonus to Armor Class and to all saving throws.

magicItems.name: Ring of Protection
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, this ring grants a +1 bonus to Armor Class and to all saving throws.

magicItems.name: Bracers of Defense
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned by someone wearing no armor and using no shield, these bracers add +2 to Armor Class.

magicItems.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
magicItems.description: While worn with the hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to spot the wearer have disadvantage and the wearer has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.

magicItems.name: Boots of Elvenkind
magicItems.description: These soft boots let the wearer move without making sound, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on staying quiet.

magicItems.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, these gauntlets set the wearer's Strength score to 19 if it isn't already higher.

magicItems.name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, this belt sets the wearer's Strength score to 21 if it isn't already higher.

magicItems.name: Belt of Frost Giant Strength
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, this belt sets the wearer's Strength score to 23 if it isn't already higher.

magicItems.name: Belt of Cloud Giant Strength
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, this belt sets the wearer's Strength score to 27 if it isn't already higher.

magicItems.name: Belt of Storm Giant Strength
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, this belt sets the wearer's Strength score to 29 if it isn't already higher.

magicItems.name: Amulet of Health
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, this amulet sets the wearer's Constitution score to 19 if it isn't already higher.

magicItems.name: Headband of Intellect
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, this headband sets the wearer's Intelligence score to 19 if it isn't already higher.

magicItems.name: Weapon, +1
magicItems.description: A magic weapon granting a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

magicItems.name: Weapon, +2
magicItems.description: A magic weapon granting a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

magicItems.name: Weapon, +3
magicItems.description: A magic weapon granting a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

magicItems.name: Armor, +1
magicItems.description: Magic armor granting a +1 bonus to the wearer's Armor Class.

magicItems.name: Armor, +2
magicItems.description: Magic armor granting a +2 bonus to the wearer's Armor Class.

magicItems.name: Armor, +3
magicItems.description: Magic armor granting a +3 bonus to the wearer's Armor Class.

magicItems.name: Shield, +1
magicItems.description: A magic shield granting a +1 bonus to Armor Class beyond the shield's normal benefit.

magicItems.name: Shield, +2
magicItems.description: A magic shield granting a +2 bonus to Armor Class beyond the shield's normal benefit.

magicItems.name: Shield, +3
magicItems.description: A magic shield granting a +3 bonus to Armor Class beyond the shield's normal benefit.

magicItems.name: Flame Tongue
magicItems.description: As a bonus action, this sword erupts in flame that lasts until dropped or extinguished, adding 2d6 fire damage to each hit and shedding bright light.

magicItems.name: Frost Brand
magicItems.description: This sword adds 1d6 cold damage on a hit, grants resistance to fire, and can quench nonmagical flames nearby. In cold surroundings it sheds dim light.

magicItems.name: Sword of Sharpness
magicItems.type: Weapon (any sword that deals slashing damage)
magicItems.description: On a hit, an extra 4d6 slashing damage; when you roll a natural 20 on an attack, the blade can sever one of the target's limbs.

magicItems.name: Vorpal Sword
magicItems.type: Weapon (any sword that deals slashing damage)
magicItems.description: This +3 sword ignores slashing resistance, and on a natural 20 against a creature with a head, it lops the head off, killing anything that can die that way.

magicItems.name: Holy Avenger
magicItems.description: In a paladin's hands this +3 sword deals an extra 2d10 radiant damage to fiends and undead and projects an aura that grants nearby allies advantage on saves against spells.

magicItems.name: Dancing Sword
magicItems.description: As a bonus action you can toss this sword into the air to fight on its own, attacking and hovering near you for a few rounds before it drops or returns to your hand.

magicItems.name: Dagger of Venom
magicItems.description: This +1 dagger can, once per day, be coated in poison as an action; the next hit forces a DC 15 Constitution save or the target takes 2d10 poison damage and is poisoned for a minute.

magicItems.name: Sun Blade
magicItems.description: The hilt projects a blade of pure radiance that functions as a finesse longsword dealing radiant damage, with a +2 bonus and extra dice against undead, and it sheds sunlight in a wide radius.

magicItems.name: Sentinel Shield
magicItems.description: While holding this shield, its bearer has advantage on initiative rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

magicItems.name: Boots of Speed
magicItems.description: As a bonus action you can click the heels together to double your walking speed and impose disadvantage on opportunity attacks against you, for up to 10 minutes per rest.

magicItems.name: Winged Boots
magicItems.description: These boots grant a flying speed equal to your walking speed for up to 4 hours of use, spendable in increments, recharging over time.

magicItems.name: Broom of Flying
magicItems.description: This broom hovers and carries a rider through the air at a fast flying speed, and it will come when its owner calls it by name.

magicItems.name: Ring of Free Action
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, difficult terrain doesn't slow you and you can't be paralyzed or restrained by magic, and grapples don't reduce your speed.

magicItems.name: Ring of Spell Storing
magicItems.description: This ring can hold spells cast into it totaling up to 5 levels; the wearer can later cast any stored spell using the original caster's statistics.

magicItems.name: Ring of Regeneration
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, you regain 1d6 hit points every 10 minutes as long as you have at least 1 hit point, and severed body parts regrow over time.

magicItems.name: Ring of Evasion
magicItems.description: This ring holds a few charges; when you fail a Dexterity saving throw you can spend one to succeed instead.

magicItems.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
magicItems.description: Holding 7 charges, this wand casts magic missile at 1st level for 1 charge, or higher levels by spending additional charges. It recovers charges each dawn and may crumble if fully drained.

magicItems.name: Wand of Fireballs
magicItems.description: Holding 7 charges, this wand casts fireball as a 3rd-level spell for 1 charge, raising the level for each extra charge spent. It regains charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Wand of the War Mage, +1
magicItems.description: While holding this wand, a spellcaster gains a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and ignores half cover when targeting with spells.

magicItems.name: Staff of the Woodlands
magicItems.description: This +2 quarterstaff holds 10 charges powering nature spells such as animal friendship, barkskin, and pass without trace, and it can once per day transform into a full-grown tree.

magicItems.name: Staff of Power
magicItems.attunementNote: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard
magicItems.description: A +2 quarterstaff and arcane focus with 20 charges that also grants bonuses to AC and saves and powers spells like fireball, cone of cold, and globe of invulnerability; breaking it releases a devastating burst of energy.

magicItems.name: Staff of Fire
magicItems.attunementNote: by a Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard
magicItems.description: Holding 10 charges, this staff grants resistance to fire damage and casts burning hands, fireball, and wall of fire by spending charges. It regains charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Robe of the Archmagi
magicItems.attunementNote: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard
magicItems.description: This robe sets base AC to 15 plus Dexterity when unarmored, grants advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and adds to spell save DC and spell attack rolls for its wearer.

magicItems.name: Cloak of Displacement
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, the cloak projects an illusion that makes attacks against you have disadvantage; it switches off until your next turn if you take damage.

magicItems.name: Cape of the Mountebank
magicItems.description: Once per day this cape lets you cast dimension door as an action, leaving behind a puff of smoke and a whiff of brimstone when you vanish and reappear.

magicItems.name: Ioun Stone (Protection)
magicItems.description: This pale, deep-blue stone orbits your head and grants a +1 bonus to Armor Class while it does so; it can be plucked from the air or snatched away.

magicItems.name: Ioun Stone (Insight)
magicItems.description: This incandescent blue sphere orbits your head and raises your Wisdom score by 2, up to a maximum of 20, while it does so.

magicItems.name: Amulet of the Planes
magicItems.description: While attuned, you can name a location and attempt to cast plane shift; a failed DC 15 Intelligence check drops you and your companions at a random plane instead.

magicItems.name: Deck of Many Things
magicItems.description: Drawing cards from this deck triggers powerful, often uncontrollable effects that can grant wishes, wealth, and boons or hurl the drawer into imprisonment, ruin, or death.

magicItems.name: Mithral Armor
magicItems.type: Armor (medium or heavy, but not hide)
magicItems.description: This lightweight version of a medium or heavy armor removes any Strength requirement and any disadvantage the armor would impose on Stealth checks.

magicItems.name: Adamantine Armor
magicItems.type: Armor (medium or heavy, but not hide)
magicItems.description: While wearing this armor, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit, negating the extra damage from crits.

magicItems.name: Eyes of the Eagle
magicItems.description: These lenses grant advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, letting the wearer make out fine detail at great distances.

magicItems.name: Goggles of Night
magicItems.description: While worn, these goggles grant darkvision out to 60 feet, or extend existing darkvision by that amount.

magicItems.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, you stabilize automatically whenever you begin your turn dying, and Hit Dice you spend to heal restore double the usual amount.

magicItems.name: Pearl of Power
magicItems.description: Once per day, as an action, you can recover one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower.

magicItems.name: Necklace of Fireballs
magicItems.description: This necklace holds several beads; detaching one and hurling it as an action creates a fireball whose strength scales with how many beads you throw at once, requiring a DC 15 Dexterity save.

magicItems.name: Efreeti Bottle
magicItems.description: Opening this brass bottle releases an efreeti; depending on chance it may attack, grant limited service, or fulfill wishes before returning to the Elemental Plane of Fire.

magicItems.name: Spell Scroll
magicItems.description: A single spell is inscribed here; casting it expends the scroll and works even if the spell isn't on your class list, needing no components except costly material ones. Cast at the spell's level using the scroll's own save DC and attack bonus. If the spell is a higher level than you can normally cast, make a spellcasting-ability check (DC 10 + the spell's level) or the casting fails. Rarity rises with level: Cantrip/Level 1 Common, 2 Uncommon, 3–4 Rare, 5–6 Very Rare, 7–9 Legendary.

magicItems.name: Scroll of Protection
magicItems.description: Reading the scroll as an action creates a 5-foot-radius barrier around you against one kind of creature (chosen when the scroll is made). For 5 minutes such creatures can't enter or affect anything inside unless they succeed on a Charisma save, and you have Advantage on saves against them.

magicItems.name: Potion of Climbing
magicItems.description: Drinking it grants a Climb Speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour, along with Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb.

magicItems.name: Potion of Water Breathing
magicItems.description: For 1 hour after you drink this cloudy green liquid you can breathe underwater.

magicItems.name: Potion of Fire Breath
magicItems.description: For 1 hour you can use a Bonus Action to exhale fire at a target within 30 feet (2d6 fire, Dexterity save for half). The potion holds three such breaths, then its magic ends.

magicItems.name: Potion of Resistance
magicItems.description: For 1 hour you have Resistance to one damage type, determined by the potion when it's created.

magicItems.name: Potion of Growth
magicItems.description: For its duration you gain the benefits of the Enlarge effect: you become Large (if you have room), your Strength checks and saves gain Advantage, and your weapon damage increases by 1d4.

magicItems.name: Potion of Diminution
magicItems.description: You gain the Reduce effect for its duration: you become Small, your Strength checks and saves have Disadvantage, and your weapon damage drops by 1d4.

magicItems.name: Potion of Invisibility
magicItems.description: You and everything you carry turn Invisible for 1 hour, until you attack, or until you cast a spell.

magicItems.name: Potion of Flying
magicItems.description: You gain a Fly Speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour and can hover.

magicItems.name: Potion of Speed
magicItems.description: For 1 minute you gain the benefits of the Haste spell (no Concentration required).

magicItems.name: Potion of Heroism
magicItems.description: For 1 hour you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points and the benefits of the Bless spell (no Concentration required).

magicItems.name: Potion of Mind Reading
magicItems.description: You can cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 13) once, no Concentration required, within 10 minutes of drinking it.

magicItems.name: Oil of Slipperiness
magicItems.description: Covering a creature or object, the oil grants the effect of Freedom of Movement for 8 hours, or when poured on the ground creates a slippery area like the Grease spell.

magicItems.name: Oil of Sharpness
magicItems.description: Applied to one slashing or piercing weapon (or 5 pieces of ammunition), the weapon gains a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 hour.

magicItems.name: Keoghtom's Ointment
magicItems.description: This jar holds 1d4 + 1 doses. As an action a creature can swallow or apply one dose, regaining 2d8 + 2 Hit Points and ending any Poisoned condition and one disease affecting it.

magicItems.name: Dust of Disappearance
magicItems.description: Thrown into the air, this pinch of dust makes you and everything within 10 feet Invisible for 2d4 minutes; the effect ends for a creature that attacks or casts a spell.

magicItems.name: Elixir of Health
magicItems.description: Drinking it cures any disease and ends the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned conditions affecting you.

magicItems.name: Universal Solvent
magicItems.description: Applied to a surface, the solvent instantly dissolves any adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue.

magicItems.name: Restorative Ointment
magicItems.description: This jar holds 1d4 + 1 doses. A dose can heal 2d8 + 2 Hit Points, or end a poison or disease, when swallowed or applied to the skin.

magicItems.name: Wand of Web
magicItems.description: Holds 7 charges. While holding it a spellcaster can spend 1 charge to cast Web (save DC 15). It regains 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn; on a 1 rolled when its last charge is spent, it crumbles to ash.

magicItems.name: Wand of Lightning Bolts
magicItems.description: Holds 7 charges. A spellcaster holding it can spend 1 to 3 charges to cast Lightning Bolt (save DC 15) at 3rd level or higher. It regains 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Wand of Paralysis
magicItems.description: Holds 7 charges. Spend 1 charge to fire a ray at a creature within 60 feet; it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or be Paralyzed for 1 minute (repeating the save at the end of each turn). Regains 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Wand of Fear
magicItems.description: Holds 7 charges. Spend a charge to command a creature (DC 15 Wisdom save or Frightened) or to sweep a 60-foot cone that Frightens all who fail the save. Regains 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Wand of Polymorph
magicItems.description: Holds 7 charges. A spellcaster holding it can spend 1 charge to cast Polymorph (save DC 15). Regains 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Wand of Magic Detection
magicItems.description: Holds 3 charges. Spend 1 charge to cast Detect Magic from it. It regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Wand of Secrets
magicItems.description: Holds 3 charges. Spend 1 charge and the wand points toward a hidden door or trap within 30 feet, if one is present. It regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Wand of Enemy Detection
magicItems.description: Holds 7 charges. Spend 1 charge and for 1 minute the wand points toward the nearest creature within 60 feet that is hostile to you, even through most barriers. Regains 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Wand of Wonder
magicItems.description: Holds 7 charges. Spend 1 charge to unleash a random magical effect (roll on the wand's table) targeted within 120 feet. Regains 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Staff of Healing
magicItems.description: Holds 10 charges and can be wielded as a quarterstaff. A Bard, Cleric, or Druid attuned to it can expend charges to cast Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, or Mass Cure Wounds. It regains 1d6 + 4 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Staff of Striking
magicItems.description: Holds 10 charges. As a magic quarterstaff it grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls, and you can expend up to 3 charges on a hit to deal an extra 1d6 force damage per charge. It regains 1d6 + 4 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Staff of Frost
magicItems.description: Holds 10 charges and grants Resistance to cold damage. An attuned spellcaster can expend charges to cast Cone of Cold, Fog Cloud, Ice Storm, or Wall of Ice. It regains 1d6 + 4 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Staff of Charming
magicItems.description: Holds 10 charges. An attuned spellcaster can expend charges to cast Charm Person, Command, or Comprehend Languages, and can use a Reaction to absorb an enchantment spell aimed at them. Regains 1d8 + 2 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Staff of Swarming Insects
magicItems.description: Holds 10 charges. An attuned spellcaster can expend charges to cast Giant Insect or Insect Plague, or spend 1 charge to cloak themselves in biting insects. Regains 1d6 + 4 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Staff of the Python
magicItems.description: As an action you can command the staff to become a Giant Constrictor Snake under your control, or revert it. While a snake it can fight on your turn; if reduced to 0 Hit Points it returns to staff form and can't be used again until the next dawn.

magicItems.name: Staff of Withering
magicItems.description: Holds 3 charges. On a hit as a quarterstaff you can spend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 necrotic damage and force a Constitution save or the target has Disadvantage on Strength- and Constitution-based checks and saves for 1 hour. Regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
magicItems.description: A magic quarterstaff granting a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls, with several once-per-day powers that add thunder or lightning damage, deafen, stun, or blast a line of creatures.

magicItems.name: Staff of the Magi
magicItems.description: A supreme staff for a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard: it grants a bonus to spell attacks, holds 50 charges to cast a long list of powerful spells, can absorb spells cast at you to regain charges, and can be broken for a catastrophic retributive strike.

magicItems.name: Rod of the Pact Keeper, +1
magicItems.description: While holding this rod, an attuned Warlock gains a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, and can regain one expended Warlock spell slot once per long rest.

magicItems.name: Rod of the Pact Keeper, +2
magicItems.description: While holding this rod, an attuned Warlock gains a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, and can regain one expended Warlock spell slot once per long rest.

magicItems.name: Rod of the Pact Keeper, +3
magicItems.description: While holding this rod, an attuned Warlock gains a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, and can regain one expended Warlock spell slot once per long rest.

magicItems.name: Rod of Rulership
magicItems.description: As an action you can command obedience from creatures within 120 feet (Wisdom save DC 15, up to 300 creatures); those that fail are Charmed by you for 8 hours. Usable once per day.

magicItems.name: Rod of Alertness
magicItems.description: While holding it you gain a +1 bonus to Initiative and Wisdom (Perception) checks and can't be Surprised, can cast several detection and protection spells from it, and can plant it to ward the area around you.

magicItems.name: Rod of Absorption
magicItems.description: As a Reaction you can absorb a spell targeting only you, negating it and storing spell levels (up to 50). You can later spend stored levels to cast your own spells without expending slots.

magicItems.name: Rod of Security
magicItems.description: Activating the rod transports you and up to 199 companions to a tranquil demiplane paradise where you don't age and needs are met, for up to 200 days total divided among all travelers.

magicItems.name: Rod of Lordly Might
magicItems.description: A +3 mace that can transform into a flame tongue sword, a battleaxe, a spear, a climbing pole, a ram, or a compass, and holds several other once-per-day powers.

magicItems.name: Ring of Feather Falling
magicItems.description: When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

magicItems.name: Ring of Water Walking
magicItems.description: While wearing it you can stand on and move across any liquid surface as if it were solid ground.

magicItems.name: Ring of Jumping
magicItems.description: While wearing it you can cast Jump on yourself at will, as a Bonus Action.

magicItems.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
magicItems.description: Your thoughts and creature type can't be read, and you can't be compelled to speak the truth by magic or perceived as lying by magic; you also choose whether your spirit lingers in the ring if you die.

magicItems.name: Ring of Resistance
magicItems.description: While worn, the ring grants Resistance to one damage type, set by the ring's gem when it's created.

magicItems.name: Ring of Telekinesis
magicItems.description: While wearing it you can cast Telekinesis at will, though you can't affect objects being worn or carried.

magicItems.name: Ring of Spell Turning
magicItems.description: While wearing it you have Advantage on saves against spells that target only you, and a spell of 7th level or lower that you succeed against is reflected back at its caster if it required an attack roll.

magicItems.name: Ring of X-Ray Vision
magicItems.description: As an action you can see through solid matter to a depth of 30 feet for 1 minute; using it again before your next long rest risks a level of Exhaustion.

magicItems.name: Ring of Warmth
magicItems.description: While wearing it you have Resistance to cold damage and remain comfortable in temperatures as low as −50°F.

magicItems.name: Ring of Swimming
magicItems.description: While wearing it you have a Swim Speed of 40 feet.

magicItems.name: Ring of Invisibility
magicItems.description: As an action you can turn Invisible, and take a Bonus Action to become visible again.

magicItems.name: Ring of the Ram
magicItems.description: Holds 3 charges. As an action you can spend 1 to 3 charges to strike a creature within 60 feet with a spectral ram (2d10 force per charge and a possible shove). It regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Ring of Djinni Summoning
magicItems.description: Once per day you can summon a specific djinni from the Elemental Plane of Air to serve you for up to 1 hour, obeying your commands.

magicItems.name: Ring of Three Wishes
magicItems.description: Holds 3 charges. As an action you can spend 1 charge to cast the Wish spell. When the last charge is used, the ring becomes nonmagical.

magicItems.name: Hat of Disguise
magicItems.description: While wearing it you can cast Disguise Self at will.

magicItems.name: Cloak of Arachnida
magicItems.description: The cloak grants Resistance to poison, a Climb Speed and spider-climb movement, immunity to webbing, and the ability to cast Web once per day.

magicItems.name: Cloak of the Bat
magicItems.description: In dim light or darkness you gain Advantage on Stealth, can grip the cloak to fly, and can spend Hit Points to briefly become a bat.

magicItems.name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
magicItems.description: While wearing it with the hood up you can breathe underwater and have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.

magicItems.name: Slippers of Spider Climbing
magicItems.description: While wearing them you can walk on vertical surfaces and ceilings, leaving your hands free, though slippery surfaces still resist you.

magicItems.name: Boots of Levitation
magicItems.description: While wearing them you can cast Levitate on yourself at will.

magicItems.name: Boots of Striding and Springing
magicItems.description: Your walking speed becomes 30 (if lower) and is unaffected by being encumbered, and you can jump three times the normal distance.

magicItems.name: Boots of the Winterlands
magicItems.description: You gain Resistance to cold damage, ignore difficult terrain from ice and snow, and can tolerate temperatures as low as −50°F.

magicItems.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
magicItems.description: When hit by a ranged weapon attack you can use a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier, and if reduced to 0 you catch the missile if a hand is free.

magicItems.name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing
magicItems.description: Climbing and swimming don't cost extra movement, and you gain a +5 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks to climb or swim.

magicItems.name: Bracers of Archery
magicItems.description: You gain proficiency with the longbow and shortbow and a +2 bonus to damage rolls with them.

magicItems.name: Brooch of Shielding
magicItems.description: While wearing it you have Resistance to force damage and immunity to the Magic Missile spell.

magicItems.name: Cap of Water Breathing
magicItems.description: While wearing it underwater you can create an air bubble that lets you breathe normally.

magicItems.name: Decanter of Endless Water
magicItems.description: Speaking a command word pours out fresh or salt water — a gentle stream, a fountain, or a powerful geyser that can knock creatures over.

magicItems.name: Driftglobe
magicItems.description: This fist-sized sphere can be commanded to shed Light or Daylight and to hover in place or follow you.

magicItems.name: Eversmoking Bottle
magicItems.description: Opening it releases a growing cloud of thick smoke that heavily obscures a wide area until you use an action to stopper it.

magicItems.name: Folding Boat
magicItems.description: A wooden box that unfolds on command into a rowboat or a larger sailing ship, and folds back down when no longer needed.

magicItems.name: Gem of Brightness
magicItems.description: Holds 50 charges. Command words make it shed bright Light, fire a blinding beam (Constitution save), or flare to Blind everyone in a 30-foot cone.

magicItems.name: Gem of Seeing
magicItems.description: Holds 3 charges. Spend 1 charge to gain Truesight out to 120 feet for 10 minutes, seeing through illusions, invisibility, and the Ethereal Plane. Regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Helm of Comprehending Languages
magicItems.description: While wearing it you can cast Comprehend Languages at will.

magicItems.name: Helm of Telepathy
magicItems.description: While wearing it you can cast Detect Thoughts at will and, once per day, Suggestion, communicating telepathically with creatures whose thoughts you've read.

magicItems.name: Helm of Teleportation
magicItems.description: Holds 3 charges. Spend 1 charge to cast the Teleport spell from it. It regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Horn of Blasting
magicItems.description: Sounding the horn unleashes a thunderous 30-foot cone that deals 5d6 thunder damage and can Deafen creatures (Constitution save); misusing it may cause the horn to explode.

magicItems.name: Iron Bands of Binding
magicItems.description: As an action you can hurl this rusty sphere at a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet; on a hit (ranged attack) metal bands Restrain it until it escapes with a Strength check against DC 20.

magicItems.name: Javelin of Lightning
magicItems.description: A magic javelin that, on command as you throw it, becomes a bolt of lightning in a 120-foot line (4d6 lightning, Dexterity save for half) before reforming.

magicItems.name: Lantern of Revealing
magicItems.description: While lit, its hooded flame reveals Invisible creatures and objects within 30 feet of the light.

magicItems.name: Mantle of Spell Resistance
magicItems.description: While wearing this cloak you have Advantage on saving throws against spells.

magicItems.name: Medallion of Thoughts
magicItems.description: Holds 3 charges. Spend 1 charge to cast Detect Thoughts from it. It regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Necklace of Adaptation
magicItems.description: While wearing it you can breathe normally in any environment and have Advantage on saves against harmful gases and vapors.

magicItems.name: Necklace of Prayer Beads
magicItems.description: This blessed strand holds special beads (such as Bless, Cure Wounds, or Wind Walk) that an attuned Cleric, Druid, or Paladin can use to cast those spells without expending a slot.

magicItems.name: Periapt of Health
magicItems.description: While wearing this gem you are immune to disease; any disease already in you is suppressed while it's worn.

magicItems.name: Periapt of Proof against Poison
magicItems.description: While wearing this gem you are immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition, and existing poisons are neutralized.

magicItems.name: Quiver of Ehlonna
magicItems.description: This three-compartment quiver holds a great deal of ammunition and gear (arrows, javelins, even a bow or staff) while weighing little and letting you draw the right item instantly.

magicItems.name: Rope of Climbing
magicItems.description: This 60-foot rope obeys spoken commands to fasten, unfasten, knot, or move toward a point, supporting up to 3,000 pounds.

magicItems.name: Scarab of Protection
magicItems.description: While holding it you have Advantage on saves against spells, and it holds charges that can automatically save you from a necromancy spell or the harmful touch of an undead creature.

magicItems.name: Wind Fan
magicItems.description: Waving the fan casts Gust of Wind once, after which it risks tearing apart each further use before the next dawn.

magicItems.name: Wings of Flying
magicItems.description: As a Bonus Action you can activate this cloak to gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet for up to 1 hour, once per long rest.

magicItems.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Silver Raven)
magicItems.description: A silver raven statuette that becomes a living raven on command; it can carry a message and, in bird form, cast the caster's senses as an aerial scout.

magicItems.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Bronze Griffon)
magicItems.description: A bronze statuette that becomes a griffon you can ride for up to 6 hours, after which it must rest as a figurine before it can be used again.

magicItems.name: Tome of Understanding
magicItems.description: Studying this book over several days permanently raises your Wisdom by 2, to a maximum of 30, after which the tome loses its magic.

magicItems.name: Tome of Clear Thought
magicItems.description: Studying this book over several days permanently raises your Intelligence by 2, to a maximum of 30, after which the tome loses its magic.

magicItems.name: Tome of Leadership and Influence
magicItems.description: Studying this book over several days permanently raises your Charisma by 2, to a maximum of 30, after which the tome loses its magic.

magicItems.name: Manual of Bodily Health
magicItems.description: Studying this book over several days permanently raises your Constitution by 2, to a maximum of 30, after which the manual loses its magic.

magicItems.name: Manual of Gainful Exercise
magicItems.description: Studying this book over several days permanently raises your Strength by 2, to a maximum of 30, after which the manual loses its magic.

magicItems.name: Manual of Quickness of Action
magicItems.description: Studying this book over several days permanently raises your Dexterity by 2, to a maximum of 30, after which the manual loses its magic.

magicItems.name: Glamoured Studded Leather
magicItems.description: This studded leather grants a +1 bonus to Armor Class, and as a Bonus Action you can make it look like any other clothing or armor while keeping its protection.

magicItems.name: Mariner's Armor
magicItems.description: While wearing this barnacle-etched armor you have a Swim Speed equal to your walking speed, and you don't take extra falling damage into water; it also grants a small AC benefit while worn.

magicItems.name: Armor of Resistance
magicItems.description: While worn and attuned, this armor grants Resistance to one damage type, chosen when the armor is created.

magicItems.name: Elven Chain
magicItems.description: You are proficient with this fine mesh armor while you wear it, even if you lack proficiency with medium armor, and it grants a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

magicItems.name: Dragon Scale Mail
magicItems.description: Forged from a dragon's scales, this armor grants a +1 bonus to Armor Class, Resistance to that dragon's damage type, Advantage on saves against its Frightful Presence and Breath Weapon, and an occasional sense of nearby dragons of its kind.

magicItems.name: Weapon of Warning
magicItems.description: While this magic weapon is on your person you can't be Surprised (unless Incapacitated), you have Advantage on Initiative, and you and nearby allies wake at the first sign of danger.

magicItems.name: Trident of Fish Command
magicItems.description: Holds 3 charges. Spend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast (save DC 15) on a beast with a Swim Speed. Regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

magicItems.name: Mace of Smiting
magicItems.description: A magic mace granting a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls (+3 against Constructs). A hit on a Construct deals extra bludgeoning damage, and a critical hit can shatter it outright.

magicItems.name: Mace of Disruption
magicItems.description: A magic mace granting a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls; it deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage to Fiends and Undead, and can Frighten or even destroy weakened ones.

magicItems.name: Scimitar of Speed
magicItems.description: A magic scimitar granting a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls, and each turn you can make one attack with it as a Bonus Action.

magicItems.name: Sword of Wounding
magicItems.description: A magic sword whose hits inflict lingering wounds: on a hit the target takes 1d4 ongoing necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns until it succeeds on a Constitution save to stanch all such wounds, and its Hit Point maximum can't be restored meanwhile.

magicItems.name: Sword of Life Stealing
magicItems.description: When you roll a 20 on an attack with this magic sword, the target takes an extra 3d6 necrotic damage (if it isn't a Construct or Undead) and you gain that many Temporary Hit Points.

magicItems.name: Vicious Weapon
magicItems.description: When you roll a 20 on an attack with this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 2d6 damage of the weapon's type.

magicItems.name: Nine Lives Stealer
magicItems.description: A magic sword granting a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls, holding charges that let a critical hit force a target to succeed on a Constitution save or be slain outright.

magicItems.name: Luck Blade
magicItems.description: A magic sword granting a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls; while it's on your person you gain a bonus to saving throws, can reroll one failed d20 per day, and the blade may hold a stored Wish.

magicItems.name: Defender
magicItems.description: A magic sword granting a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls, of which you can choose each turn to divert some of the bonus to your Armor Class instead.

magicItems.name: Oathbow
magicItems.description: Naming a target as your sworn enemy grants Advantage against it, extra 3d6 piercing damage on hits, and other benefits, but leaves you with Disadvantage on attacks against other creatures until the enemy is dead or you rest.
